messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content:
viscous friction force depends on relative angular velocity, damping coefficient, and viscosity.
viscosity plus shape and size affect the damping coefficient.
coefficient terms should be added to the physical pendulum model when damping is not negligible.
negligible damping means the ideal undamped model is enough.
